say:1:1230177001:1.text: Well... Many join the Water Wights because they struggle to make ends meet and are unhappy with the Carmine Whispers. Everyone looks out for each other and I like them.
say:1:1230177001:1.source_cn: 好还是不好……很多人都是没活干、没吃的，不服血薇帮才加...

say:2:1230177002:1.text: But the Dead Tide Fleet is a different story... We just want to stay alive, but the fleet doesn't care about our safety at all.
say:2:1230177002:1.source_cn: 但是，死潮舰队就是另一回事了……我们只想活着，但死潮舰...

say:3:1230177003:1.text: Hard to believe I'm the only one back.
say:3:1230177003:1.source_cn: 最终回到这个码头的，竟然只剩下我。

say:4:1230177004:1.text: In hindsight, Kawa's indecisiveness might not be so bad after all.
say:4:1230177004:1.source_cn: 现在看起来，像奇卡瓦这样犹豫，或许也并不是坏事。
